summary: Nora can build you a file — a report, a chart, a rendered map, a document — and hand back a link to it, instead of typing the answer into chat.
details: Ask for something that wants to be a file and she builds it in a sandboxed container, then shares the link.
Quick jobs come back in the same reply. A long one gets an honest "I'm working on it" and then arrives later as its own message, in her own words, without anybody having to ask again.
A result that arrives while the group is mid-conversation with her waits its turn rather than talking over it.
An existing artifact can be revised in place, keeping the link that was already shared.
One job, one delivery, ever: a finished job is never announced twice, and a job that failed is reported as a failure rather than dressed up as a result.
limitations: Off by default. It needs the sandbox image built and the Docker socket available, and Nora refuses to start with it switched on until every credential it needs is present — a missing one would otherwise fail every job silently.

A restart while a job is in flight loses the delivery: the job is reported as lost rather than guessed at, and the request has to be made again. A container still running at that point is orphaned and finishes unwatched.
Two jobs run at a time; a third waits.
